intended: To the Editor, I am writing in response to your article of last Thursday concerning the proposed closure of the Harbour Road Library. A guy walks up at 6 a.m., completely soaked, no luggage, and says he's checking in under the name of his brother, who is apparently already in the room. I said, sir, I can't give you a key without ID, he said, fine, I'll go get him, and he disappears. Twenty minutes later he comes back with his brother, who is in a bathrobe and also wet, and it turns out they'd both fallen in the fountain outside. Long story short, we gave them towels and a free breakfast and now they've booked another night. The manager was thrilled.
